items.raw_excerpt: In an age where every concert, festival, and conference is viewed through a five-inch glass screen, living in the present has become a radical act. We have all seen it: a major artist takes the stage, and thousands of phones instantly shoot into the air, turning a shared human experience into a digital recording session.
items.summary_en: A new podcast talks with Micael Lopes about live events and phone use. Many fans film whole concerts instead of watching them. The show asks how people can be truly present again.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 한 팟캐스트가 미카엘 로페스와 함께 공연장과 휴대폰 사용에 대해 이야기한다. 많은 관객이 공연을 보는 대신 영상으로만 찍는다. 이 방송은 사람들이 어떻게 다시 그 순간에 집중할 수 있을지 묻는다.
items.title_en: A podcast in Portugal asks people to put their phones down at concerts
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 팟캐스트, 공연장에서 휴대폰을 내려놓자고 말하다
items.title_original: Reclaiming the Room: How TIME&SPACE is Bringing Human Presence Back to Live Events - Podcast with Micael Lopes

items.raw_excerpt: La estación de Tobalaba registró 110,8 milímetros de lluvia en 24 horas, mientras que en Viña del Mar se contabilizaron 125,2 milímetros. La Dirección Meteorológica reportó un superávit de precipitaciones respecto de los niveles habituales para esta época del año.
items.summary_en: Rain set records in Santiago and Valparaíso at the start of October. The Tobalaba station in Santiago measured 110.8 mm of rain in 24 hours, while Viña del Mar recorded 125.2 mm. Weather officials say this is more rain than usual for this time of year.
items.summary_ko: 10월 초 산티아고와 발파라이소에 기록적인 비가 내렸다. 산티아고의 토발라바 관측소는 24시간 동안 110.8밀리미터를, 비냐델마르는 125.2밀리미터를 기록했다. 기상청은 이 시기 평년보다 비가 많다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Rain sets records in Santiago and Valparaíso in early October
items.title_ko: 10월 초 산티아고와 발파라이소에 기록적인 비
items.title_original: Lluvias marcan récord en Santiago y Valparaíso durante inicio de octubre

items.summary_en: Puerto Escondido started a campaign called 'Yo me Sumo' to keep the town clean. The program teaches residents in local neighborhoods how to separate their trash. Officials hope it builds a stronger habit of proper waste disposal.

items.summary_en: Julia Cardy is walking across Prince Edward Island for two weeks. She carries a flag her friend April Huggett once carried for 700 kilometres in Ukraine. The walk raises money for Ukrainian soldiers.

items.raw_excerpt: The government says the cost of its machete bin amnesty program came in at $6.55 million and collected more than 12,000 weapons.
items.summary_en: The state of Victoria ran a machete bin amnesty program. It cost 6.55 million dollars. People handed in more than 12,000 weapons, and also everyday items like butter knives and kitchen scissors.

items.raw_excerpt: Siti Nur’ain Awari turned them into bears and quilts her children could keep. That idea grew into Patchwork Handmade Keepsakes, where the mum of four has transformed other kids' clothes, from baby onesies to school uniforms, into treasured mementos.
items.summary_en: A mother of four in Singapore turns her children's old clothes into memory items. She makes bears and quilts, from baby onesies to school uniforms. This small hobby grew into a thriving home business.

items.title_en: She turns old kids' clothes into keepsakes

items.raw_excerpt: Jenny Woodward received the honour at the Queensland Clarion Awards for journalism, where the ABC also picked up prizes for camerawork, sports journalism and other categories.
items.summary_en: Jenny Woodward has received a top honour at the Queensland Clarion Awards. The award marks her 40 years of work presenting news. ABC also won prizes for camerawork and sports journalism.

items.raw_excerpt: Vincent Tan, who helped shape the three-Michelin-starred restaurant’s wine programme, is taking on a new group role at Park90 as it expands across Southeast Asia.
items.summary_en: Vincent Tan was the wine director at Odette, a famous three-star restaurant in Singapore. After 10 years, he is leaving to join Park90, a wine group growing across Southeast Asia.

items.raw_excerpt: The brolga holds an important place in Gunditjmara culture and is an indicator of wetland health, but their numbers are under threat.
items.summary_en: Drying wetlands in southern Australia are putting brolgas at risk. The birds are important to Gunditjmara culture and show the health of wetlands.

items.raw_excerpt: Former Mayor accuses govt of plans to relocate Thiruvananthapuram Zoo animals, forms protection committee to keep it in place.
items.summary_en: A former mayor says the government wants to move the animals of Thiruvananthapuram Zoo to Vantara in Puthur. He has formed a protection committee to keep the zoo where it is. The zoo is a beloved spot for families in Kerala's capital.
items.summary_ko: 한 전 시장이 정부가 티루바난타푸람 동물원의 동물들을 푸투르의 반타라로 옮기려 한다고 주장했습니다. 그는 동물원을 지금 자리에 그대로 두기 위한 보호 위원회를 만들었습니다. 이 동물원은 케랄라주 수도에서 가족들이 즐겨 찾는 곳입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Fortunately for paleogeneticists, wolf puppies don't chew their food thoroughly.
items.summary_en: A frozen wolf from Siberia still had food in its stomach. Scientists found woolly rhino DNA inside and pieced together the rhino's genome. This is the first genome from this extinct animal.
items.summary_ko: 시베리아에서 발견된 얼어붙은 늑대의 뱃속에 먹이가 남아 있었습니다. 과학자들은 그 안에서 털코뿔소의 DNA를 찾아 유전체를 복원했습니다. 이 동물의 유전체가 밝혀진 것은 이번이 처음입니다.
items.title_en: Scientists read a woolly rhino genome from a 14,400-year-old wolf's stomach
items.title_ko: 1만 4400년 된 늑대 뱃속에서 코뿔소 유전자를 읽다
items.title_original: Scientists sequence a woolly rhino genome from a 14,400-year-old wolf’s stomach - Ars Technica

items.raw_excerpt: Huachipato tumbó por 2-0 a O'Higgins en Talcahuano y llegó a 10 encuentros consecutivos de forma invicta ante los de Rancagua. Con goles de Maximiliano Rodríguez y Claudio Sepúlveda no solo amplió su paternidad, si no que llegó a tres encuentros al hilo festejando en la Liga de Primera.
items.summary_en: Huachipato won 2-0 against O'Higgins in Talcahuano. Goals from Maximiliano Rodríguez and Claudio Sepúlveda sealed the win. It was Huachipato's third straight victory in the league.

items.title_en: Huachipato beats O'Higgins 2-0 in Talcahuano
